title: Maarva Andor
description: Maarva and Clem Andor raised their adopted son, Cassian Andor, on Ferrix. She worked in secret for the nascent Rebellion against the Galactic Empire. After Maarva's death, B2EMO played a holographic message from Maarva that encouraged Rebellion. The message set off a riot as the people rose up against the Imperial forces.
